words.preconditions: A fresh RFQ event, published, with one QA vendor invited; bidding open for about 20 minutes.
steps: The buyer invites QA vendor 2 to the live pricing round.
The buyer sets the invited vendor's price cap on the round to 120 (a bid must be strictly below it) for the invited QA vendor.
The buyer sets the invited vendor's price cap on the round to 105 (a bid must be strictly below it) for a second QA vendor.
The invited QA vendor opens a bid on the pricing round.
The invited QA vendor reads the pricing round.
As the invited QA vendor, read the pricing round and check that Status check: the reply's status code is a success (2xx — the request worked).
words.expected: The app accepts it. Read back afterwards: Status check: the reply's status code is a success (2xx — the request worked).
